photos.name: finished-rolls-in-car
photos.summary: Four finished birote rolls on a round wire cooling rack wrapped in a white cloth towel, sitting on a car seat for transport. Golden-brown crust with flour dusting and lengthwise scores. More torpedo-shaped than bake 1.

photos.name: mise-en-place
photos.summary: Overhead mise en place on granite counter — glass bowl with tan levain, bowl of AP flour, small dish of salt, large empty glass mixing bowl with red lid. Scale and bench scraper visible.
